premises.text: Commercial job sites suffer preventable water leaks, mold, and fire damage with no active fire monitoring on most sites
premises.evidence_span: there's currently no active fire monitoring solution for most job sites today

premises.text: Real-time end-to-end environmental sensor networks provide active warning and damage mitigation on job sites
premises.evidence_span: Pillar is the first real-time, end-to-end environmental monitoring solution designed specifically for the job site

premises.text: Sensor data supports logistics placement of equipment and management of personnel exposure
premises.evidence_span: the data is actually usable for logistics. So we can help contractors better place equipment and better manage personnel exposure to potentially harmful conditions

premises.text: Stored construction environmental data creates a building history transferable to future owners
premises.evidence_span: Now your building has a Carfax. All that data is stored and passed on

premises.text: Alerts push to smartphones so contractors need not learn new dashboard software
premises.evidence_span: contractors don't want to learn a new piece of software. So that's why we push notifications directly to the smartphone

premises.text: Pricing is a one-time per-square-foot install fee plus monthly per-square-foot SaaS bundling hardware, firmware, software, and analytics
premises.evidence_span: we charge $0.03 per square foot one-time installation fee, and $0.02 per square foot per month

domains.name: Job-site water, mold, and fire damage

value.text: Buildings built with less time, less money, and higher quality via preventable-damage monitoring
value.evidence_span: we're going to change the way buildings are built. Less time, less money, and with a quality never before seen

causal_links.evidence_span: most of which were preventable or mitigatable if they had a monitoring solution
we do active warning and damage mitigation
